data.name: Chinese Newcomer
data.detailed_description:
1st Player Story Collection | The Chinese Newcomer

We’re now collecting real-life stories from our players!

Share your life choices, career experiences, and personal insights, and your story could become an official in-game event.

📅 Submission Deadline: May 28

🏆 Selected: 5–10 entries

🎁 Rewards: - Official game activation code - Permanent in-game credit for your story (optional)

📩 Submit to: 3454424793@qq.com

      QQ Group: 954173781

Join us and leave your mark in *The Chinese Newcomer*.


About the Game

Game Introduction

The Chinese Newcomer is a lightweight single-player life simulation RPG. Set within a vintage Chinese hardcover notebook, it centers on "event-based choices" as you experience the full life cycle of decisions from workplace novice to industry titan. Navigate the delicate balance between physical stamina and wealth, and embark on a cross-generational journey of family legacy.

Core Gameplay

From fresh graduate to retirement across five major life stages, every choice leaves its indelible mark in ink. When a playthrough concludes, the scroll unfolds—and your workplace family precepts are born.

Three Paths

  • Craftsmanship Path — Deepen your professional expertise to become a technical luminary

  • Integrity Path — Master interpersonal wisdom to thrive in all situations

  • Moderation Path — Reject the rat race to find inner harmony and balance

Key Features

📒 Notebook Narrative

Rice paper pages, hardcover UI, and brush calligraphy annotations. This isn't just a game—it's writing your very own life journal.

🃏 Roguelike Three-Choice Path Progression

Choose one of three abilities at each stage upgrade to unlock permanent buffs. No tedious operations—only pure strategic decision-making.

💰 The Crossroads of Wealth

An authentic Stock Market Survival Guide is fully integrated into the game, covering everything from candlestick chart fundamentals to position management discipline—turning the financial thinking you develop in the game into real-life wisdom.

📜 Write Your Legacy — Your Workplace Family Precepts

After each playthrough, the scroll unfolds to reveal your ratings and attribute traits. This is your one-of-a-kind life diagnosis.

🌳 Centennial Family Legacy · Cross-Generational Inheritance

Featuring an exclusive Five Elements Family Precept Talent Tree. Your playthrough evaluation converts into Family Legacy Points, unlocking talents for the next generation.

🔄 Seamless Full Life Cycle Simulation

Experience the complete five major life stages in a single playthrough: Survival, Ascent, Breakthrough, Steadfastness, and Fulfillment. The 35-year-old crisis, retirement... every authentic life crossroad is yours to decide.

⚡ Fragmentation-Friendly, Pick-Up-and-Play

Each playthrough lasts 30-45 minutes, playable in short sessions. No in-app purchases, no pay-to-win mechanics. Pure single-player life simulation.

"Every choice in life writes your own story."

Now, open the notebook that belongs to you.

data.short_description: "Chinese Newcomer" blends deck-building with career simulation. Players choose one of three cards to collect, manage stamina. Use "Legacy Points" to grant Five-Elements talents to descendants, rectifying past regrets. Make choices along paths and embarking on a multi-generational journey.

English*, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Any modern dual-core processor (e.g., Intel Core i3 or equivalent AMD)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent), supporting OpenGL 2.1
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any dedicated GPU or newer integrated graphics (To ensure smooth performance during multitasking/background operations, rather than due to game demands)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
